text:
june: heads-up — BigBank SQ incoming. They want: proof of KMS key rotations (6mo), RBAC change history for prod service accounts (1y), audit-log exports for IR (immutable + 13mo retention), and confirmation we support HSM-backed keys and split-knowledge ceremonies. Who can assemble artifacts? @maria @aj :raising_hand:

sec-bot: created ticket SEC-8823: 'BigBank SQ - KMS/RBAC/Logs evidence' assigned to @maria, due 2026-05-12 :white_check_mark:

maria: I can take point. Quick clarifying q: for "proof of rotation" do they accept KMS audit events (rotate/create key version) + key version list, or do they want exported wrapped key metadata + signed timestamp?

aj: they usually accept audit events + key version history + signing of exported metadata. For HSM we can provide attestation statements from vendor. BigBank asked about dual-control — we should include our key-rotation playbook excerpt.

sam: RBAC history is in infra-iam repo and Cloud/Audit logs. I can pull a changelog for prod service accounts. shorthand: git log --since="1 year ago" --pretty="%h %ad %s" -- infra/iam/roles && gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName:"SetIamPolicy" AND resource.labels.project_id="prod"' --limit 100

maria: adding examples for log/export commands (will include both AWS and GCP samples):

```
# AWS CloudTrail lookup for KMS RotateKey events
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=RotateKey --start-time 2025-11-01 --end-time 2026-05-01
\n# GCP audit logs query for KMS key version creations
gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.CryptoKeyVersion.Create"' --freshness=180d --format=json > kms-rotation-events.json
```

maria: for the rotation timeline I'll produce: CSV of key_id, version, created_at, rotated_by, rotation_event_log_link + screenshots of console event if needed.

dave: for audit export we already have a workflow. Exports go to s3://redwood-audit-exports/bigbank/ with WORM enabled. retention=13 months. Quick command to bundle and sign: 

```
# bundle
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit-exports/bigbank/2026-04-*/ ./bigbank-logs/ --recursive
tar -czf bigbank-audit-2026-04.tar.gz ./bigbank-logs/
# sign
sha256sum bigbank-audit-2026-04.tar.gz > bigbank-audit-2026-04.sha256
openssl dgst -sha256 -sign /opt/keys/ir-signing-key.pem bigbank-audit-2026-04.sha256 | base64 > bigbank-audit-2026-04.sig
```

aj: note re: HSMs — Private/on-prem supports PKCS#11 HSMs and we have a CMEK integration for cloud KMS. For third-party HSM attestation, we can provide NV ocsp/attestation doc and CSR fingerprint. If they require key escrow proof, we need to route to legal.

sam: RBAC output will include a diff of bindings for prod service accounts and a CSV of changed members + roles. Example snippet of the CSV header: service_account,role,action,timestamp,changed_by

maria: vuln/IR tie-in: BigBank asked for evidence that past critical CVEs affecting inference-runtime were triaged and mitigated. I'll attach the vuln-triage ticket list and closure notes. Quick link: https://issues.redwood.ai/SEC-TRIAGE/637 (will include redacted CVE details).

june: timeline? they want initial package in 5 business days. Is that feasible?

maria: EOD Friday (2026-05-15) for a preliminary package (rotation CSV + RBAC diff + a single month of signed logs). Full export (13mo) may take a bit longer; ETA next Tue 2026-05-19.

dave: I'll start the export job now and tag objects with bigbank/request-2487654321. Will enable S3 object lock for the export batch.

aj: I'll draft the HSM attestation + key ceremony notes and hand them to @maria for inclusion.

maria: checklist I'm producing: [1] key rotation timeline CSV, [2] signed audit tarball (sample month), [3] RBAC change diff + CSV, [4] vuln triage list + closure notes, [5] key ceremony + HSM attestation excerpt, [6] playbook excerpt for IR evidence gathering.

june: perfect. I'll reply to the BigBank contact with the EOD Friday ETA and ask if they want interim screenshots now.

sam: FYI — if they ask for signed audit logs with customer-provided key, we support that via external key signing; I'll note the flow in the ticket.

maria: one more: include a short MD5/sha256 manifest for each artifact so they can verify integrity after download.

june: thanks team. I'll keep BigBank updated. ping me in thread if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
